issue.title: test_existing_typeahead_seeds_finder_query raises NoMatches for #existing-finder-preview-body in a Full CI 3.13 leg

task_type_fields.evidence:
Proposed by phase sase-1mk.9.3 (note #4, epic sase-1mk.9) and triaged by the sase-1mk.9 land agent.

Full CI 39164596460 (master 457dd728d5, 2026-10-18) job 117787890929 `full / test (3.13)` failed this node with `textual.css.query.NoMatches: No nodes match '#existing-finder-preview-body'`. The traceback runs from the `release.wait(timeout=10)` slow-rows patch at tests/ace/tui/actions/test_prompt_mini_macro_location_flow_existing.py:264 into `app.run_test` teardown (textual message_pump dispatch). That suggests the finder preview body was queried after the finder was unmounted or before it composed, while the typeahead keys were pressed during a held `_load_unified_save_rows` call.

Fail/pass: 1 failure, in the 3.13 leg only. The node passed in the 3.12 and 3.14 legs of the same run. It also passed in every later Full CI (39172267490 at 5fe54b5974, 39178872128 at 1276b73b8b, 39187446189 at dd963c0fa6) and in every Master Gate shard since. It never reproduced serially; no local stress run has been done. The epic did not cause it: none of sase-1mk.9's phases touched the mini-macro location flow.

issue.creation_reason: Phase sase-1mk.9.3 saw this Full CI-only failure outside its link-follow scope, and no existing task bead tracks this node or its preview-body NoMatches.
